title: Verlinde 2010: On the Origin of Gravity and the Laws of Newton (Entropic Gravity)
efc_relevance: Newton's law as an entropic force on holographic screens. Direct conceptual predecessor of EFC; EFC replaces the holographic screen with a dynamical entropic field S(x) on a lattice and extends to perturbation sector. Shared a0-emergence (Verlinde's a0 ∼ cH0 rediscovered in EFC).
ledger_action: Logged as closest direct predecessor. Explicit parent-citation in WP1 and Elevator Pitch.
